title: continue the AntiGravity task you just created. Do not create…
objective:

Then test through the real installed Jarvis path:

Do not declare completion from campaign_runner, unit tests, process IDs, or worker claims. Finish only after the real Jarvis production path reproduces the commands successfully and Argus verifies the actual requested outcome.
